title: Class A CDL Driver
description:
Class A CDL Driver-Local
This is a Career Opportunity!! Direct Hire!
NO OTR, home every night!
Shift: Monday thru Friday: 7:00am – 5:00pm
Pay rate: $25-$30+
E Syracuse, NY

Our Client is a leading provider of space solutions. Our Client operates a fleet of nearly 100,000 modular space and secure storage units. We are looking for an experienced Class A CDL Driver. This is a full time DIRECT HIRE position including benefits.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:
Our CDL Drivers drive a 3+ ton truck to deliver, relocate, and return units to and from customer locations; perform set-ups and knockdowns, install value-added products, such as decks, ramps and stairs and maintain service and safety of our units during transportation. • Some knowledge of computers is necessary and good communications skills are required for dealing with customers, salespeople, contractors, shop personnel as well as team members at various locations.

title: Maintenance Mechanic
description:
Maintenance Mechanic

Pay: $26.00-$28.00/hour, paid weekly
Location: High Point, NC 27262
Schedule: Full-Time

Shift Schedule: Candidates must be available to work all shifts

  • 1st Shift: 6:00 AM - 2:30 PM
  • 2nd Shift: 2:00 PM - 10:30 PM
  • 3rd Shift: 10:00 PM - 6:30 AM

Duration: Contract with the potential for permanent hire based on performance.


Overview

Support daily maintenance operations within a manufacturing facility by troubleshooting, repairing, installing, and maintaining production equipment and facility systems. This role works closely with the Maintenance & Engineering Manager to minimize equipment downtime, improve reliability, and support safe, efficient manufacturing operations.


Key Responsibilities

Equipment Maintenance & Repair

  • Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain manufacturing equipment, including tank mixers, air diaphragm pumps, valves, piping, boilers, and related mechanical systems.
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and mechanical equipment.
  • Install new equipment and upgrade existing production systems.

Instrumentation & Controls

  • Calibrate, troubleshoot, and repair instrumentation, including:
    • Flow meters
    • Flow switches
    • Level sensors
    • Temperature transmitters
    • Actuated valves
    • Associated control interlocks

Preventive Maintenance

  • Complete preventive and reactive maintenance work orders according to production priorities.
  • Identify equipment issues before failures occur and proactively perform repairs or report concerns.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records, work logs, parts inventory, and preventive maintenance documentation.

Engineering Support

  • Assist with engineering projects involving equipment layout, system design, specifications, equipment evaluations, process improvements, and data collection.
  • Support new equipment installations and process improvement initiatives.

Safety & Housekeeping

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Follow all company safety policies and procedures.


Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Minimum of 5 years of maintenance experience in a manufacturing environment or equivalent experience.
  • Ability to work overtime, including weekends, as needed.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds regularly.
  • Ability to perform frequent physical activities, including standing, walking, climbing, bending, reaching, kneeling, crouching, pushing, pulling, and repetitive movements.
  • Comfortable working around dust, chemicals, fumes, temperature extremes, and other industrial environmental conditions.


Required Skills

  • Strong troubleshooting skills for mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems.
  • Experience repairing and maintaining industrial manufacturing equipment.
  • Ability to read and complete maintenance work orders and documentation.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to prioritize changing workloads in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Commitment to workplace safety and quality standards.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with intrinsically safe and explosion-proof electrical systems for Class I, Division I environments.
  • PLC troubleshooting and maintenance experience.
  • Welding and pipefitting experience.


Physical Requirements

  • Frequently lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
  • Perform repetitive bending, kneeling, crouching, climbing, reaching, pushing, and pulling.
  • Work in manufacturing environments with exposure to dust, fumes, chemicals, machinery, and varying temperatures.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Operations Data Analyst
Duration: 8 month contract

Data analytics ( Python, excel, conduct data queries as needed)

SAP
Microsoft, excel and power query as needed

Soft skills:
Problem solving mentality
Willingness to learn ( Copperleaf, Foundry, GIS, and other platforms)
Impeccable organization skills
Agility

Position Summary
The Data Analyst is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive operational and strategic decision-making. This role requires an exceptional communicator who can clearly explain data, assumptions, and insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike. The ideal candidate is highly proficient in Power BI for reporting and visualization and Foundry for advanced analytics and data modeling, and is comfortable working across multiple enterprise systems and teams.

Responsibilities:

Data Analysis & Insights
• Analyze business data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities for operational and strategic improvements
• Demonstrate broad expertise in data processing and analysis, applying analytical techniques to a wide range of business questions
• Respond to ad hoc and recurring data requests with accuracy, clarity, and timeliness

Data Management & Integration
• Collect, clean, validate, and integrate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency
• Extract and analyze data from SAP to support planning, forecasting, and decision-making
• Manage data extraction and transfer from databases to support operational analysis across teams
• Create automated data routines and processes to ensure efficient, repeatable reporting and data delivery

Reporting, Visualization & Tools
• Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI to clearly communicate insights and performance metrics
• Utilize Foundry for advanced analytics, data modeling, and analytical workflows ( knowledge of Foundry is preferred, not a requirement)
• Apply GIS tools for spatial data analysis and mapping to support location-based decision-making
• Leverage Copperleaf for asset investment planning, lifecycle cost analysis, and value-based decision support ( knowledge of Copperleaf is preferred, not a requirement)

Communication & Collaboration (Core Requirement)
• Clearly communicate analytical findings, assumptions, and recommendations to diverse audiences
• Translate complex data into concise, compelling narratives that support informed decision-making
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, identify challenges, and deliver data-driven solutions
• Act as a trusted partner to stakeholders by helping shape analytical questions and clarify insights

Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
• Demonstrated experience building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI
• Strong SQL skills and experience working with structured datasets
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to explain complex data clearly
• Strong ability to interpret data, identify trends, and generate actionable insights
• Ability to clearly communicate complex data findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Experience working in cross-functional teams and translating business needs into data-driven solutions.


Desired Qualifications:
- Hands-on experience using Foundry for data analysis, data modeling, or workflows
- Experience with Copperleaf

Location : East Hanover, NJ 07936 (Open to fully remote candidates located in the EST or CST time zones, as well as local candidates)
Pay rate : $50.00 - $57.50
Duration: 5 month contract

Overview

Operating within the Ventures Procurement team, the Project Manager leads end-to-end productivity projects focused on raw materials and packaging. This role drives cost savings, material changes, and supply chain efficiencies by managing supplier transitions, procurement optimizations, and specification modifications. The Project Manager oversees projects throughout their lifecycle to guarantee they are delivered on time, within scope, and remain financially viable while directing cross-functional corporate stakeholders.

Must Have Skills / Requirements

  • Industry Project Management : Proven experience executing project management methodologies within a procurement, supply chain, consumer packaged goods (CPG), or manufacturing corporate environment.

  • Sourcing Comprehension : Strong operational understanding of raw materials and packaging sourcing strategies, material specifications, and logistics.

  • Cross-Functional Influence : Demonstrated ability to manage, lead, and influence matrixed cross-functional teams without having direct authoritative reporting lines.

  • Financial Acumen : Solid financial proficiency with experience building business cases, tracking cost-savings, and assessing complex project financials.

  • Communication & Tools : Highly refined communication and presentation skills tailored for executive-level reporting, along with deep proficiency in project management software tools.
